description: Real Pending/Funded/Claimed StockBack state for one wallet. Pending is a promised USD value not yet backed by a purchase; Funded means a real on-chain stock purchase already confirmed and is waiting to be claimed; Claimed means it was already sent to the wallet. Works for any address, including ones that have never earned anything.
name: get_stockback_vault
title: Get a wallet's real StockBack balances
